      Ventana de reseñas: 28 jun 2026 - 11 ago 2026

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Kaka hindustan gamer_, 11 ago 2026, 1/5: "I'm a free user, I delete this app due to paywall because can't work for analyse my weekly tracker & monthly widgets & still the main feature of the app habit tracker is not work because you have to pay for this"
